decisions.reason: As a recently launched classic door lever handle in the firm's core hardware range, it would normally be given more time in the market before any discontinuation decision.
A door lever handle family broadens the catalog and is typically retained by a large German fittings manufacturer unless there is clear early failure, which is not indicated here.
A new door handle design is close to the firm's established business and design-led variants usually stay on offer for more than a single year after launch.
This door handle design is another incremental product in the core assortment, so management would usually keep it rather than withdraw it immediately after launch.
A door lever handle family supports range depth and customer choice, which large German industrial suppliers typically preserve unless performance is clearly poor.

Although an electronic access system is more complex and commercially riskier than mechanical handles, its highlighted unique technology suggests strategic importance and argues for keeping it on the market.
